Merge pull request #13 from srmainwaring/prs/apply-position-offset

Apply stored position offset in velocity and effort control modes

data.author: Rhys Mainwaring
data.message:
Adjust the position by the stored position offset in velocity and effort control modes

- Cache the servo position offsets in on_activate
- The stored position offset is only applied to the position by the servo when in position control mode.
- Ensure consistent position reporting in velocity and effort modes when the position offset is non-zero.

Signed-off-by: Rhys Mainwaring <rhys.mainwaring@me.com>

data.author: brukg
data.message:
add velocity/effort control modes, mode switching, and fix read latency
   - Add velocity and effort command/state interfaces to hardware driver
   - Add prepare/perform_command_mode_switch for controller-driven mode switching
   - Support SMS_STS servo modes: 0=position, 1=velocity closed-loop, 2=PWM/effort
   - Add configurable default_control_mode hardware parameter
   - Fix read latency from ~160ms to ~15ms by using cached FeedBack data (pass -1)
     instead of making individual serial reads per register
   - Remove unnecessary 10ms sleep between servo reads
   - Invert effort command sign to match servo PWM direction
